meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 在 claude-mem 的观察者任务里,Claude 只回两种内容:没有可留内容时回 skip_summary 标签,完成可检索单元时回一条 observation XML(含标题、4–10 条带路径的事实和叙述),不写散文。
howto.when: 当 claude-mem 的观察者任务交给它时(claude-mem 生成循环、Grok Bot 上的 observer job 等),由它接管这次回复。

say.text: 跑一遍这个 observer 任务,别写散文。
这个搜索单元请生成 observation,标题别用工具名。
say.note: 会产出含 4–10 条带路径事实的 XML。

say.text: 没有实质内容就直接 skip_summary。
say.note: 返回 reason 为 noise 的空结果。

howto.what_en: Inside claude-mem observer jobs, Claude replies with only one of two things: a skip_summary tag when nothing is worth keeping, or one observation XML with a real title, 4-10 facts with paths and a narrative. It never writes prose.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a claude-mem observer job (claude-mem generator loop, an observer job on Grok Bot, etc.) is handed to it; it then takes over the reply.

say_en.text: Run this observer job and reply without prose.
say_en.note: It returns only skip_summary or one observation XML.

say_en.text: Produce an observation for this searchable unit, no tool-name titles.
say_en.note: Outputs XML with 4-10 facts and paths.

say_en.text: If there is nothing real, just skip_summary.
